components.name: Default Button
components.description: The charcoal action for the main step in a local workflow.
components.css: .ds-button-default { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: #27272a; color: #ffffff; font: 500 14px/1.2 Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-default:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #27272a 90%, transparent); } .ds-button-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #28796b; outline-offset: 3px; border-color: #28796b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #28796b 50%, transparent); } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-button-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 3px; } } .ds-button-default:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; }

components.description: A compact written marker for incomplete or cautionary evidence.
components.css: .ds-badge-warning { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #e4cea4; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff8e9; color: #80580b; font: 500 12px/1.5 Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: This is a light desktop operating system for reading a market month without turning the work into a dashboard spectacle. White working space, soft zinc surfaces, charcoal actions, a restrained teal selection, and visible rules let the figures, evidence, and Turkish labels do the work. The sidebar keeps the working context close while the content area stays broad, dense, and calm. Colour carries state sparingly: teal locates the current path, green and red support signed values, and amber keeps incomplete evidence visible. The system is intentionally light-only and uses native controls where they already serve the workflow.
keyCharacteristics: Light zinc shell with charcoal primary actions and restrained teal selection.
Segoe UI hierarchy, tabular figures, visible rules, and compact operational density.
Native tables, selects, disclosures, and SVG trend chart retained beside three shared controls.
Explicit warning, unavailable, synthetic, and report-evidence states.

rules.name: The Accent Is Location Rule
rules.body: Teal marks focus, selection, and progress. It does not certify profit or a favourable financial result.

rules.name: The Comparable Figures Rule
rules.body: Amounts, totals, and tables use tabular numerals; numeric table columns align right and retain their units and signs.

rules.name: The Overlap-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows explain an overlay. Standard cards, rows, and figures stay flat.

dos: Do keep the period, cutoff, synthetic identity, and evidence state readable where the owner works.
Do use the light paper-and-zinc surfaces, visible separators, and tabular figures to support scanning.
Do use teal for the current path and keyboard focus, and pair positive, negative, and amber colour with written context.
Do preserve native table scrolling and disclosure behavior when extending an existing workflow.
donts: Don't restore the superseded navy rail, electric-blue action system, or dark component variants.
Don't use teal, green, or red alone to assert financial meaning.
Don't replace missing evidence with a zero or hide it to make a compact view cleaner.
Don't add a generated control framework where the native table, select, disclosure, or chart already owns the task.
